summary.title: How to Create a Telegram Bot using Python
summary.one_liner: You learn how to create a Telegram bot with pyTelegramBotAPI, handle commands and echo messages, and build a multi-step horoscope bot that calls a horoscope API.
takeaways: Create a bot token by talking to BotFather in Telegram with the /newbot command, and store the token securely.
Install pyTelegramBotAPI with pip and read the token from an environment variable into a TeleBot instance.
Register message handlers with decorators such as message_handler(commands=...) and a lambda filter that echoes all text.
Use register_next_step_handler() to chain messages, asking for a zodiac sign and then a day before fetching a horoscope from an API with requests.
Bots stop when the Python process stops; deploying to a platform such as Heroku or Render keeps it running.
summary.summary: The article walks through creating a Telegram bot in Python. It covers getting a bot token from BotFather, setting up the pyTelegramBotAPI library with an environment variable for the token, and writing handlers for /start, /hello, and an echo of all messages. It then builds a horoscope bot that uses message chaining via register_next_step_handler to ask for a zodiac sign and a day, and fetches data from a horoscope API using requests. The author notes that deployment to a hosting platform is needed for the bot to run continuously.
